children.title: Tankers
children.summary: VLCC spree this week as we recorded eight units changing hands, mainly to Emirati buyers.

children.title: Bulkers
children.summary:
The Baltic Dry Index closed today to a peak of 3,089 points, reflecting a 13% increase
compared to last Friday's closure of 2,732 points. Despite August summer holidays kicking in, the S+P
activity remains strong, with another busy week recording 10 transactions (mainly larger tonnage),
comprising 2 capes, 4 kamsarmaxes, 1 Panamax, 2 Supramaxes & 1 Handysize bulk carriers.

children.title: Demolition
children.summary:
The Subcontinent markets are overall healthy; Pakistan is the hottest market due to local
steel market improvement. Indian local steel market is stabilizing while Bangladesh is softening due to
local steel market getting slower.
